orderNo.description: The order number associated with the payment

paymentLinkRef.description: The payment link reference of the transaction you requested the details for

from.description: The mobile number of the sender used when sending payment link.

to.description: The end-user’s mobile number that the payment link was sent to (In international format, e.g., 27831234567).

paymentStatus.description: The new status of the payment

paymentStatusId.description: The ID of the payment status

currency.description: The currency that the transaction was conducted in

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the transaction

additionalData.description: Any additional data over and above what is already included that you want to store in the database along with that record and/or return in the response

paymentStatusConversionTime.description: This field will contain the timestamp received from the Payment Gateway when a transaction which was in a Review status was finalized.

paymentStatuses.description: The list of all payment status transitions

environment.description: Chat 2 Pay configuration run environment (SANDBOX or PRODUCTION)

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the transaction

paymentGatewayDecision.description: Decision received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

paymentGatewayReqReferenceNumber.description: Payment Reference number received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

paymentGatewayResponseTimestamp.description: Timestamp received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

paymentGatewayResponseCode.description: Response code received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

paymentGatewayErrorDecision.description: Error description received back from Payment Gateway if error occurred

paymentGatewayAuthReconciliationReferenc.description: Unique number generated by Payment Gateway to identify the transaction for the payment request

cardType.description: The type of card used for the transaction, as received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

maskedCardNumber.description: The masked card number used for the transaction, as received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

cardExpiryDate.description: The expiry date of the card used for the payment, as received back from the Payment Gateway for the payment request

PaymentStatusLogResponse.description: The list of all payment status transitions
